rareResources.name: Zero-Point Capacitor
rareResources.desc: Vacuum power source and anchor for a Research District, increasing that district's research output by 25%.

rareResources.name: Antihydrogen Reservoir
rareResources.desc: Farm District anchor and colony dispatch reserve. Stores 2000 units of each warp fuel so its network can operate without the Peregrine.

rareResources.name: Sentinel Battery
rareResources.desc: Built into a Research District, where its superconducting mount steadies the instruments and carries the colony's 40-round fire-control battery.

rareResources.name: Closed Ecology Column
rareResources.desc: Civilian District anchor. Recycles air, water and waste for 1000 people; food still requires farms or supply ships.

rareResources.name: Ectogenesis Bank
rareResources.desc: Built into a Civilian District, where it raises people from stored genetic lines and returns viable ones to the vault.
